issues.issue: Whether the appellant's forced-marriage account is credible given contradictions about the marriage dates and certificate
issues.applicant_position: Her testimony was not confused; RPD ignored her testimony and misread the marriage dates.
issues.result_text: Confusion and contradictions on the marriage undermine credibility on a central claim issue.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD erred in dealing with the handwritten document and refusing a postponement
issues.applicant_position: She had not received the handwritten sheet and needed time to review it before the hearing.
issues.result_text: No error found in the RPD's treatment of the handwritten document or her testimony about it.
